Class ViewLessonsList

java.lang.Object
guiLessonsList.ViewLessonsList
public class ViewLessonsList extends Object

Title: ViewLessonsList Class.

Description: The Java/FX-based Lessons Learned list page. It is the page a contributor reaches from their home page, and it shows every stored lesson, newest first, with a search box, a category filter, and an "only my lessons" choice above the list. From here the contributor can record a new lesson or open the selected one.

The page is laid out the way every non-Admin page in TP1 is: the title centred at the top, a label above each control rather than placeholder text inside it, exactly one filled button (New Lesson), and Back and Quit drawn quietly at the foot of the page. The column is wider than on the login pages because a lesson line needs the room; the reasons for every other choice are recorded in guiTools.Theme and in TP1's User Experience.pdf.

As in every supplied View, this class is a singleton. The constructor builds the widgets once; displayLessonsList(Stage, User) fills in what changes each time the page is shown.

Contributor stories supported: CS-2, CS-3, CS-4, CS-5, CS-6, and the entry point to CS-1.

  • Method Details

    • displayLessonsList

      public static void displayLessonsList(javafx.stage.Stage ps, entityClasses.User user)

      Method: displayLessonsList(Stage ps, User user)

      Description: The single entry point from outside this package that displays the Lessons Learned list page. It establishes the shared attributes, instantiates the singleton the first time, reads every lesson from the database so the list is current, clears any search left over from an earlier visit, and shows the page.

      Parameters:
      ps - the JavaFX Stage to be used for this GUI and its methods
      user - the User for this GUI and its methods

    • refreshList

      public static void refreshList(javafx.stage.Stage ps, entityClasses.User user)

      Method: refreshList()

      Description: Shows the current list again without reading the database, used when the user returns from the detail page or the editor. The shared list in the Model already holds any change those pages made, and the search and filters the user had set are kept, so they come back to what they were looking at.

      Parameters:
      ps - the JavaFX Stage
      user - the logged in User
